properties.description: Tumbling-window trigger over the same pipeline. NOT a duplicate of the schedule trigger - it solves a different problem. A schedule trigger fires and forgets: if 5 March fails, nothing re-runs it. A tumbling window trigger owns a contiguous, gap-free series of windows, tracks each window's state, supports `retryPolicy`, and can be re-run for a historical window from the ADF monitor with two clicks. That makes it the right tool for a warehouse where every month must eventually succeed. Left Stopped in ALL environments, including prod: starting it with startTime in the past causes ADF to immediately queue every window since that date, which on a 2019 start date means 70+ concurrent backfill runs. Read docs/06-data-factory.md#tumbling-windows before you start it.
